🔢 Barcodes
Give every product a code so it can be scanned at billing.
🏷️ New here? Read this first (click to hide / show)
A product's Item Code / Barcode is the number under the barcode on the packet (or any short code you make up). At billing, scanning or typing this code instantly adds the product to the cart.
⚠️ No code = the product can't be scanned (you'd have to tap it).   Duplicate code = two products share a code, which breaks scanning — give each its own.
How to set a code
1  Find the product (search below)  →  2  Click the box and scan the barcode with a scanner gun, or type a code  →  3  Click the green Save.
Tip: use the real barcode on the packet so any scanner reads it. Tap a column heading filter to find products that still need a code.
